text: **Minor unrelated observation** (logged in the writeup, not investigated further): during the real-relay session, a "publish already in flight: <event id>" toast got stuck on screen and visually blocked the Chats "New message" button until I navigated away and back. The referenced event (a kind:10050 republish) had actually already succeeded on the relay — looks like a stale in-flight-publish tracking entry that never cleared on ack. Flagging in case it's worth its own issue later; didn't chase it down since it wasn't blocking. [...] **Filed honestly:** stuck publish-in-flight toast (chirp#54).
